Package persistence

Class JsonManager<T,ID>

java.lang.Object
persistence.JsonManager<T,ID>
Type Parameters:
T - Type of the objects.
ID - Type of the identification for the objects.
All Implemented Interfaces:
DataListManager<T,ID>, DataManager<T,ID>
Direct Known Subclasses:
JsonGameSessionManager, JsonHidatoManager, JsonUserManager
public abstract class JsonManager<T,ID> extends Object implements DataManager<T,ID>, DataListManager<T,ID>
Abstract class that implements the interfaces for data and list management for JSON files storage. The name for an object file is the object's ID and the name for a list file is the name of the list.
